synopsis: “Make me a princess!” One day, Yuma Kanbara finds himself in a tough spot, when his younger sister, Ayane, blackmails him with a certain cringe-worthy secret from his past. Her demand? To secure her a spot among the “Hime 6,” the prestigious titles awarded only to the top six candidates in Himegasaki Academy’s famous general election. Determined to claim the throne, Ayane leverages Yuma's weakness to make him “conquer” her rival princess candidates to clear the path to her victory. But winning over the school’s most captivating beauties is no easy task, and Yuuma struggles at every turn… Worse still, as he gets involved with the girls, he finds himself getting tangled up in the increasingly complicated romantic lives of the princesses themselves! With egos laid bare and love and scheming colliding at full force, the most chaotic romantic comedy ever is about to begin! (Source: SB Creative, translated)

title: Gate: Where the JSDF Fought
titleRomaji: Gate: Jieitai Kanochi nite, Kaku Tatakaeri
titleNative: ゲート―自衛隊彼の地にて、斯く戦えり
synonyms: Gate: Thus the JSDF Fought There
เกท - หน่วยรบตะลุยโลกต่างมิติ
synopsis: One day in the 21st century, a gate opened in the middle of the Ginza district of Tokyo. Out of the gate poured soldiers and strange creatures, and they soon made Ginza look like an image of hell. The gate apparently connected Japan to another world, a world with a militant empire and many supernatural creatures. The Japanese Self-Defense Force decided to send a small group, led by a soldier who's also an otaku, into the other world on a reconnaissance mission. They're meant to learn what they can about the empire (and its plans), the world, and the people. They're hardly in the world yet, though, when they come across a village destroyed by a giant fire-breathing dragon. The only survivor is an unconscious elven girl they find hidden in a well. Now they feel like they must warn the nearby towns about the dragon, and do what they can to help. On the way, they'll meet more magical, female companions, and learn more about this dangerous new world.
